text_en: How the gold has grown dim, how the pure gold is changed! The sacred stones lie scattered at the head of every street.
text_cn: 怎么！黄金竟暗淡无光，纯金竟变了色！圣所的石头都散乱在街头！

text_en: The precious children of Zion, worth their weight in fine gold— how they are reckoned as earthen pots, the work of a potter’s hands!
text_cn: 熙雍的子女，原比纯金尊贵，怎么现在竟被看作瓦器，被看作陶人的出品！

text_en: Even the jackals offer the breast and nurse their young, but my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
text_cn: 豺狼尚且露出乳房，哺养自己的幼儿；我的女儿──人民，竟然残暴不仁，好似旷野中的鸵鸟！

text_en: The tongue of the infant sticks to the roof of its mouth for thirst; the children beg for food, but no one gives them anything.
text_cn: 婴儿的舌头，干渴得紧贴上颚；幼童饥饿求食，却无人分给他们。

text_en: Those who feasted on delicacies perish in the streets; those who were brought up in purple cling to ash heaps.
text_cn: 昔日饱享山珍海味，今日竟饿死街头；一向衣饰华丽，而今却满身粪土。

text_en: For the chastisement of my people has been greater than the punishment of Sodom, which was overthrown in a moment, though no hand was laid on it.
text_cn: 我的女儿──人民的罪罚，比索多玛的还重，索多玛顷刻间倾覆了，并非假手于人。

text_en: Her princes were purer than snow, whiter than milk; their bodies were more ruddy than coral, their hair like sapphire.
text_cn: 昔日，她的少年，比雪还洁白，比乳还皎洁；他们的皮肤，比珊瑚还红润，他们的身体好似一片青玉。

text_en: Now their visage is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as wood.
text_cn: 而今，他们的容貌，比炭还黑，在街上已辨认不出，皮包骨头，枯瘦如柴；

text_en: Happier were those pierced by the sword than those pierced by hunger, whose life drains away, deprived of the produce of the field.
text_cn: 死于刀下的，比死于饥饿的，即因缺乏田产，日渐衰弱而死的，更为幸运。

text_en: The hands of compassionate women have boiled their own children; they became their food in the destruction of my people.
text_cn: 柔情的妇女竟要亲手烹食自己的子女；在我的女儿──人民遭受浩劫时，子女竟成了母亲的食物。

text_en: The Lord gave full vent to his wrath; he poured out his hot anger, and kindled a fire in Zion that consumed its foundations.
text_cn: 上主大发震怒，倾泄了他的怒火，火烧熙雍，焚毁了他的基础。

text_en: The kings of the earth did not believe, nor did any of the inhabitants of the world, that foe or enemy could enter the gates of Jerusalem.
text_cn: 地上的君王和世上的居民，谁也不相信：仇敌能进入耶路撒冷的城门。

text_en: It was for the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, who shed the blood of the righteous in the midst of her.
text_cn: 这是由于她先知们的罪恶，和她司祭们的过犯：他们在城中心，倾流了义人的血；

text_en: Blindly they wandered through the streets, so defiled with blood that no one was able to touch their garments.
text_cn: 他们身染血污，像瞎子一样，徘徊街头，叫人不能触摸他们的衣服。

text_en: “Away! Unclean! ” people shouted at them; “Away! Away! Do not touch! ” So they became fugitives and wanderers; it was said among the nations, “They shall stay here no longer. ”
text_cn: “不洁！退避！”人们喊说：“退避！不可接近！”如果他们逃亡，漂流异邦，异邦人又说：“不要让他们留居此地。”

text_en: The Lord himself has scattered them, he will regard them no more; no honor was shown to the priests, no favor to the elders.
text_cn: 上主的怒容驱散他们，不再垂顾他们；人也不再尊敬司祭，不再敬重长老。

text_en: Our eyes failed, ever watching vainly for help; we were watching eagerly for a nation that could not save.
text_cn: 我们还在望眼欲穿，幻想着我们的救援；我们仍在瞭望台上，期望着那不能施救的异邦。

text_en: They dogged our steps so that we could not walk in our streets; our end drew near; our days were numbered; for our end had come.
text_cn: 敌人正在追踪我们的足迹，阻止我们在街上行走；我们的结局已近，我们的日子已满；的确，我们的终期已到。

text_en: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles in the heavens; they chased us on the mountains, they lay in wait for us in the wilderness.
text_cn: 追捕我们的人，比凌空的飞鸟还要快速；他们在山上搜索我们，在旷野里窥伺我们。

text_en: The Lord ’s anointed, the breath of our life, was taken in their pits— the one of whom we said, “Under his shadow we shall live among the nations. ”
text_cn: 连我们的气息──上主的受傅者，也落在他们的陷阱中：我们原希望在他的福荫下，生活在异邦人中。

text_en: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter Edom, you that live in the land of Uz; but to you also the cup shall pass; you shall become drunk and strip yourself bare.
text_cn: 住在胡兹地的厄东女郎！你欢欣喜乐吧！苦爵也要轮到你喝；你将要醉倒，而赤身裸体。

text_en: The punishment of your iniquity, O daughter Zion, is accomplished, he will keep you in exile no longer; but your iniquity, O daughter Edom, he will punish, he will uncover your sins.
text_cn: 熙雍女郎！你的罪债已经偿还，上主不再使你流徙；厄东女郎！他必要惩罚你的过犯，揭露你的罪恶。
